description: Clearest trigger: the opponent has three stones stacked at the top of column 0 (leftmost) with the cell above empty, so I must block on top of column 0. It fires less when columns 1-2 are filled. Horizontal or diagonal threats in column 0, my own column-0 three, and the mirror case in column 6 do not fire. Most other firing is weak, scattered left-side positions with no single pattern.
effect: none measurable: steering moves probabilities by at most about 0.05 (e.g. small shifts between neighbouring columns); forced blocks are unchanged.
notes: Best dev F1 0.237 (P 0.53, R 0.15; AUROC 0.57), simulation share 0.01. Tried: any must-block (F1 0.12), col-0 three restricted to low col 1 (0.19, P 0.69), any opponent threat in col 0 (0.11), col-0 must-block at row>=2 (0.22). Minimal pairs confirm the col-0 vertical three strongly and in a left-side-specific way (mirrors ~0). About 85% of firing (mostly near threshold) is unexplained, and it is sensitive even to far filler stones, so this looks like a mixture or a random direction. Synthesis combining a quiet top trigger with a col-0 three reaches 6.9 against a dev max of 4.1.
